title: Roccavento island · borghi, evacuation and the 30/10 playtest fixes
description: The next version: everything on main plus the Roccavento island, where settlements are managed borgo by borgo, and the fixes from the 30 October playtest.
scenario: Roccavento island (borghi and districts), Valverde and Selvariva with their borghi
highlights: EvacuateDistrict: evacuate a borgo with paced departures; Borghi tab in the scenario editor
Players reply in one box: «Reply to the inject», mandatory basis (plan, law or operational judgement) and rationale
EXCON replies close once handled; «View as <role>» shows a player's map in «Information to roles»
Buildings are damaged only when the confirmed fire reaches them; Extinguish keeps the vegetation
Warned zones stay marked with their time, behind the fog of war for players
Scenario texts in English, map labels in every player language
